values.note: 19 campsites, 11 reservable (BLM). The recreation.gov catalog lists 18 sites with vehicle lengths 25-80 ft (only one under 40 ft).

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/red-mountain-mt ('The campground has 19 camp sites, 11 available for reservations') + recreation.gov catalog for 261804 (max vehicle lengths 25, 40, 43, 45 x3, 50 x7, 72, 75, 80 x3), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 3 accessible vault toilets; drinking water in peak season only (recreation.gov 'Drinking Water (peak season)'). Firewood sold when the volunteer host is present; wood collecting is prohibited in the lower Madison corridor.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/red-mountain-mt ('19 campsites, 3 accessible vault toilets, drinking water, horseshoe pit, and picnic tables') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261804 (amenity 'Drinking Water (peak season)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: BLM: 'Campsites are available for reservation for the Peak-Season times of May 1st through September 15th. From September 16th through April 30th, all sites are first-come-first-serve.' Drinking water and the volunteer host are seasonal.
$20 a site (2026-2027 peak season, May 1 - Sept 30); additional vehicles $5 each, paid on site; maximum 3 vehicles per site (truck and camper trailer count as one).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261804/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-01 to 2026-09-30, Campsites $20) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261804 (notice 'Additional Vehicles are $5 each. Maximum vehicle limit is 3 per campsite'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: BLM Dillon Field Office; unstaffed, volunteer seasonal host. 11 of 19 sites reservable May 1 - Sept 15 on recreation.gov ('Reservations are available on a rolling 6-month basis'); the rest first-come, and all sites first-come Sept 16 - April 30. Stays limited to 14 nights in a rolling 30 days. Sites must be occupied nightly. Full on peak-season weekends.

booking.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/red-mountain-mt (Overview) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/261804 (notices; rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 nights rolling 30 days), read 2026-10-22

note: BLM (Dillon Field Office) campground beside the lower Madison River, ~9 mi NE of Norris off MT-84 via South Bear Trap Canyon Road, roughly halfway between the Warm Springs boat launch and Black's Ford FAS. No boat launch at the campground. Popular with anglers and summer tubers; near the Bear Trap Canyon unit of the Lee Metcalf Wilderness and Norris Hot Springs. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 19 sites (11 reservable, rest FCFS), no electric, vault toilets, drinking water, $20 (2026), recreation.gov. Added max rig 80 ft (catalog), year-round season (reservable May 1 - Sept 15, all first-come Sept 16 - Apr 30), 6-month window for this campground, 14-night limit. Not stated: senior/access discount (inherited left). Note trimmed of restated values.
